title: superclaude sets CAIRN_USER to the session it launches
intention: Every Claude session superclaude launches carries CAIRN_USER=cc<instance> into everything it runs, so cairn's caller record and the bus can name which Claude it is.
why: Akien 2026-10-13 (verbatim at ideas/2026-10-13-so-lets-talk-first-about-the-cairn.json): "we set CAIRN_OPERATOR= this can be OPERATOR or Akien or whatever... Akien is a subclass of operator, and mostly this gets used for reporting... but when we use cairn superclaude or cairn cc0 or cairn librarian or whatever... we also set the otherwise unset variable CAIRN_USER= which can be librarian or cc0 or whatever. if CAIRN_USER is set, then it's you... if it's not, then it's me." He set export CAIRN_OPERATOR=Akien in ~/.bashrc (line 166) the same day. Measured 2026-10-13: launchers/superclaude computes session=<host>_cc_<instance> (:220-226) and exports no CAIRN_USER, so nothing a Claude session runs declares it is Claude except CLAUDECODE, which rehearsal strips.
traces_to: Akien's spec verbatim in why, and Law 7 (a record of truth names the hand that wrote it).
how: launchers/superclaude only: right after session="${host}_cc_${instance}" (:226), `export CAIRN_USER="cc${instance}"` (overwriting any inherited value), with a two-line comment citing this ticket and Akien's words.
falsifier: launchers/proofs/test_superclaude_sets_cairn_user.py under PROVES {'8c899e9ea338': {'1','2','3'}}, using the fake-CLAUDE_BIN harness of launchers/proofs/test_superclaude_wire.py with a fake claude that writes its environment to a file: (1) a default launch hands the fake CAIRN_USER=cc0; (2) --instance=2 hands it CAIRN_USER=cc2; (3) a launch from a parent environment carrying CAIRN_USER=zzz hands it cc0, not zzz. Hollow: today's superclaude reds 1-3.
watchme: none, because the fault is measured at /home/akien/dev/src/cairn/launchers/superclaude and the proof's teeth are its falsifier
intent_berth: none, because Akien specified it in conversation 2026-10-13, his words recorded verbatim at /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/ideas/2026-10-13-so-lets-talk-first-about-the-cairn.json and quoted in why

decisions.text: The value is cc<instance> (cc0, cc1), Akien's own spelling ('cairn cc0'). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-12
